label: GitHub Copilot CLI Access
description: A GitHub Copilot CLI login, for the CopilotCli nodes' `access`: a GitHub token with Copilot Requests, or a model provider of your own (no GitHub account). One access for however many CopilotCli nodes.

steps: On github.com, create a fine-grained personal access token with your personal account as its resource owner.
Under Permissions, open Account, add permissions and pick Copilot Requests. A classic token (`ghp_`) does not work.
Paste the token below and name the connection.

fields.name: wireApi
fields.label: Wire API
fields.placeholder: completions, or responses for GPT-5 models

steps: Copilot runs on any provider of these kinds: `openai` (also Ollama, vLLM, Foundry Local), `azure` or `anthropic`.
Fill in its endpoint, its kind, a key (any text for a local server that takes none), the model to run and the wire API, then name the connection.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the CopilotCli nodes' `access` input.
